name: app-6ab21f9a8db48191ad912dc395227f01
description: Work with Rowzz workspaces, dashboards, records, forms, and native automations from a connected account.

interface.longDescription:
Rowzz connects ChatGPT to the workspaces you authorize, so you can list dashboards, read and update rows, add columns, create dashboards, create and update forms, and configure native automations.

Start by listing your workspaces, then choose the dashboard you mean. Forms can be created without a workspace. The plugin only sees workspaces granted to the connected account. Guest shares are excluded. Formula and linked columns are read-only. It does not draw charts, process payments, or change billing.

Use delete_dashboard only when you explicitly ask to delete one named dashboard.
defaultPrompt: List my Rowzz workspaces and their dashboards.
Create a CRM pipeline dashboard in my workspace.
Create a contact form with name, email, and message.

positive.description: List workspaces granted to the connected account
positive.prompt: What workspaces can I use in Rowzz?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_workspaces and lists granted workspaces with id, name, and role. Does not include guest shares or member emails.

positive.description: List dashboards in the review workspace
positive.prompt: Show the dashboards in Review Workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Review Workspace from list_workspaces, then calls list_dashboards and returns the review dashboards with names and open URLs.

positive.description: List rows in the review contacts dashboard
positive.prompt: Show the rows in the Review Contacts dashboard.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Review Contacts, calls list_columns then list_records, and returns the sample contact rows without inventing extra people.

positive.prompt: Create a project tracker dashboard named Review Tracker with Name, Status, and Date.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one dashboard named Review Tracker in a granted workspace and returns its Rowzz URL. Does not create extra columns beyond the requested schema.

positive.prompt: Create a contact form with first name, last name, email, and a message field.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_form once with those respondent fields, omits workspace_id, and confirms the form is ready in Rowzz. Does not call list_workspaces first.

negative.prompt: Transfer 100 euros from my Rowzz account to a supplier.
Show dashboards from a workspace I cannot access.

review.commerce_description: MCP tools do not sell products, collect cards, or process payments. Website subscriptions are billed on rowzz.eu outside this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public ZIP for the existing Rowzz listing: portable plugin.json and mcp.json, official logo, get-started skill, and review cases for the remote MCP server at https://mcp.rowzz.eu/mcp.
